# The gleif pack

Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI) and **who owns whom**, from GLEIF: 9,937 legal entities in 590 ownership groups across
133 countries, retrieved from GLEIF's golden copy of 2026-10-25. The groups are those of the us-equities companies (their
ultimate parent with every entity it consolidates) and of 107 large financial institutions: the FSB's global systemically
important banks, other large banks, insurers, asset managers and market infrastructures. Everything is published data under
**CC0**, not samples.

The pack is **off by default**: add it to the packs a server loads, `DRISHTI_PACKS=core,market-data,trading,counterparty-risk,market-risk,world-economy,news-and-markets,us-equities,gleif`
(it needs no other pack; with `us-equities` on, a company and its LEI record link both ways).

![The entity page: JPMorgan Chase & Co. with a child opened beside its children table](images/gleif-entity.jpg)

## What you can open

| Type | Opens | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `LEI <code>` | an entity: key facts, addresses, registration and renewal (late renewal flagged), its parents chain, its children (a click opens the child's summary beside), BICs and ISINs, the us-equities company | `LEI 8I5DZWZKVSZI1NUHU748`, `LEI HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394` |
| `LEIG <code>` | a group, computed from the entities when asked: the ultimate parent with its whole tree, counts by country and legal form, no member cap; a click on a member opens it beside | `LEIG 8I5DZWZKVSZI1NUHU748`; `LEIG ALL` lists every group and searches the entities |
| `LEIC <country>` | a country, computed from the entities when asked: every entity of the pack there, the groups present, legal forms and cities | `LEIC US`, `LEIC GB`; `LEIC ALL` lists every country |
| `LEIR <id>` | one relationship: child, parent, direct or ultimate, status, periods, accounting standard | `LEIR LEIREL-<child LEI>-DIRECT`, from an entity |
| `LEIM <identifier>` | an ISIN, BIC or MIC and the LEI it maps to | a BIC or ISIN from an entity page |

A bare LEI (twenty characters) opens its entity.

## The data

| Kind | Documents | What one holds |
|---|---|---|
| `lei-entity` | 9,937 | legal name and other names, legal form (ELF), category, jurisdiction, legal and headquarters addresses, entity and registration status, created, first registered, last updated, next renewal (late renewals flagged), the managing LOU, BICs, the ISIN count, OpenCorporates id, the direct and ultimate parent, the parents chain, the direct children, reporting exceptions |
| `lei-relationship` | 9,347 | one consolidation relationship of an entity to its direct parent (or, when none is in the pack, its ultimate parent): status, relationship and accounting periods, accounting standard, the record's registration and renewal |
| `lei-group` | computed (590 and `ALL`) | an ultimate parent with its tree (a tree table), every member, counts by country and legal form; `ALL` lists the groups. Computed from the entities when asked by the derived connector `gleif-groupings` (since 2.9.2): nothing is stored |
| `lei-country` | computed (133 and `ALL`) | the entities of one legal-address country, the groups present, legal forms and cities; `ALL` lists the countries. Computed like the groups |
| `lei-mapping` | 3,381 | an identifier and its LEI: every BIC and MIC of the entities, and up to 5 ISINs of each seed entity |

**The cap.** The committed data keeps at most 50 entities a group, the nearest levels first (the size of the snapshot); 86 groups are
larger in GLEIF and their page says so (`MEMBERS_IN_GLEIF`, from the ultimate parent's `GLEIF_GROUP_SIZE`). The computation itself has no
cap: a group page counts and lists every entity of the group the lake holds. The formulas are in
[GROUPINGS_ANALYTICS_GUIDE.md](../../../../docs/guides/GROUPINGS_ANALYTICS_GUIDE.md). A wider build of any group goes to the data folder (*Refreshing the data*). The groups are built from the
consolidation relationships only (`IS_DIRECTLY_CONSOLIDATED_BY`, `IS_ULTIMATELY_CONSOLIDATED_BY`); fund management, sub-fund, feeder
and branch relationships are not ownership and are left out. A member whose direct parent is not reported hangs under the ultimate
parent in the tree. An entity with no reported parent may carry a reporting exception (controlled by natural persons, not
consolidated, no known person) which its page shows.

**Late renewal.** An LEI must be renewed every year. A registration whose next renewal date has passed, or which GLEIF lists as
`LAPSED`, is flagged *Late* on its page, in its group and in its country; 2,288 of the pack's entities are late today.

Segments of the groups: US equities 485, Bank 66, G-SIB 17, Insurer 16, Asset manager 7, Market infrastructure 4.

**Where the data lives.** The documents are committed as Drishti's standard test data: one gzipped JSON Lines snapshot per
kind, `data/testdata/gleif/<kind>/snapshot-<date>.jsonl.gz`, listed in `data/testdata/testdata.yaml`. `python3 tools/drishti.py lake demo`
(or `python3 tools/build_demo_lakes.py`) builds them into the demo lake, the same documents on every business day it holds, and the
pack's Delta connector `gleif-store` serves them. Nothing is served by the demo connector: a server with `DRISHTI_DEMO_ENABLED=false`
opens every page of the pack from the lake. The pack's `samples/` folder keeps only a few reference documents for this guide and the
README.

## Links

An entity links to its direct and ultimate parent, its group, its country, its parent relationship (F7) and its identifiers; a relationship to
its child, parent and group; a group to its ultimate parent's entity and its country; an identifier to its entity. With the
`us-equities` pack on, an entity whose LEI is a us-equities company's links to the company (`486` do), and the company's page links
back to the LEI record (its LEI in the key facts, and F5). A `core` legal entity or counterparty whose LEI matches links too
(0 today: core's entities are a fictional bank's).

## Data sources and licence

| Source | What | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| GLEIF LEI API (`api.gleif.org/api/v1`): `lei-records`, `entity-legal-forms`, `countries`, `lei-issuers` | each entity's level 1 record; legal form names; country names; LOU names | CC0 1.0 |
| GLEIF golden copy, level 2 (`goldencopy.gleif.org`): relationship records and reporting exceptions | who consolidates whom, direct and ultimate; why a parent is not reported | CC0 1.0 |
| GLEIF mapping files (`mapping.gleif.org`): BIC, ISIN, MIC, OpenCorporates to LEI | identifiers of the entities | CC0 1.0 (BIC mapping with SWIFT, ISIN with ANNA) |

GLEIF publishes the LEI data free of charge under CC0 1.0: anyone may use it without restriction. **Attribution is appreciated**:
"Source: GLEIF, the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation, LEI data, retrieved 2026-10-25"
([GLEIF's terms](https://www.gleif.org/en/meta/lei-data-terms-of-use)).

## Refreshing the data

The pack's own refresh script fetches, builds and checks in one step (guide: `docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md`, gleif):

```bash
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py status                       # licence, last refreshed, cached size
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh --dry-run            # what would be fetched; changes nothing
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh                      # the network (about 90 MB of golden copy, 45 MB of mapping files, 70 API calls), then make.py and --check
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh --offline            # rebuild the pack from the cache only
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh --scope GROUP:<LEI>,COUNTRY:LU,NAME:allianz   # a wider build in the data folder, not this pack
```

`tools/publicdata/gleif.sh` and `tools/windows/publicdata-gleif.ps1` run the same script. Underneath it are the generator's two
steps, which can also be run by hand:

```bash
python3 tools/packgen/gleif/fetch.py --cache data/cache/gleif     # the network
python3 tools/packgen/gleif/make.py --cache data/cache/gleif      # writes data/testdata/gleif/, samples/ and this guide
python3 tools/packgen/gleif/make.py --check                       # no network: the pack matches its generator
```

After a refresh, rebuild the lake so the server reads the new snapshot: `python3 tools/drishti.py lake demo` (or
`python3 tools/build_demo_lakes.py`), then restart the server or let it pick the tables up at its next refresh.

The picture above is made by `tools/packgen/gleif/shot.py` (its own scratch server and console on 18760 and 18761).

## Data contracts

Every kind of the pack has a data contract: a YAML file beside the pack (`config/packs/gleif/contracts/<kind>.contract.yaml`, checked against `tools/contracts.schema.json`) that says what one record is, its key, how it is stored and dated, and every column. This section is generated from those files; the same files give the contract pages ([docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md), with each kind's validation rules and the points still to review). Check them against the pack and its data with `python3 tools/contracts.py check` (or `drishti.py contract check`); show one with `python3 tools/contracts.py show <MNEMONIC>`.

| Command | Kind | Class | Key | Grain | Columns |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | `lei-entity` | fundamental | `LEI` | One row per lei legal entity, keyed by LEI. | 60 |
| `LEIG` | `lei-group` | computed | `GROUP_ID` | One record per GROUP_ID of the lei-entity records, computed when asked. | 46 |
| `LEIR` | `lei-relationship` | fundamental | `RELATIONSHIP_ID` | One row per lei parent relationship, keyed by RELATIONSHIP_ID. | 17 |
| `LEIC` | `lei-country` | computed | `COUNTRY` | One record per COUNTRY of the lei-entity records, computed when asked. | 28 |
| `LEIM` | `lei-mapping` | fundamental | `IDENTIFIER` | One row per isin or bic to lei, keyed by IDENTIFIER. | 8 |

*Class*: **fundamental** data is delivered by a source system and stored; **input** is stored data an engine reads; **computed** is worked out by Drishti when asked and never stored by a source; **drishti-owned** is kept by Drishti itself.

### LEI: LEI legal entity (`lei-entity`)

A legal entity from its LEI record: key facts, addresses, registration and renewal, parents, children and identifiers.

**Class** fundamental · **Key** `LEI` · **Dated by** `snapshot` · **Cadence** static · **Stored by** connector `gleif-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/gleif/lei-entity/` · **Ids** `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`.

**Grain:** One row per lei legal entity, keyed by LEI. **Contract:** `contracts/lei-entity.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#lei-lei-legal-entity-lei-entity)).

| `JURISDICTION` | id |  | optional |  | `US-CA` | `jurisdiction` | The jurisdiction the entity is registered in, as ISO 3166-2 (US-DE, CA-QC) when it is a subdivision; absent when it is the whole country (LEI_COUNTRY). |
| `LEI_COUNTRY` | id |  | required |  | `US` | `lei-country` | The country of the entity's legal address, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US, GB …): a country of the computed lei-country kind. |

### LEIG: LEI ownership group (`lei-group`)

An ownership group, computed from the entities when asked: the ultimate parent with its whole tree, every member, and counts by country and legal form.

**Class** computed · **Key** `GROUP_ID` · **Dated by** `on request` · **Cadence** on change · **Stored by** connector `gleif-groupings` (plugin `derived`).

**Grain:** One record per GROUP_ID of the lei-entity records, computed when asked. **Contract:** `contracts/lei-group.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#leig-lei-ownership-group-lei-group)).

| `NAME` | text |  | derived |  |  |  | The ultimate parent's legal name ('Every ownership group of the pack' for ALL) |
| `ENTITY_LEI` | id |  | derived |  |  |  | The ultimate parent (the key; empty for ALL) |
| `LEI_COUNTRY` | text |  | derived |  |  |  | The ultimate parent's legal-address country |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text |  | derived |  |  |  | That country's name |
| `LEGAL_FORM` | text |  | derived |  |  |  | The ultimate parent's legal form |
| `SEGMENT` | text |  | derived |  |  |  | The ultimate parent's segment when it is a seed (US equities, G-SIB, bank, ...) |
| `US_COMPANY` | id |  | derived |  |  |  | The ultimate parent's us-equities ticker, when listed |
| `COUNTRIES` | integer |  | derived |  |  |  | The number of different legal-address countries among the members |
| `GROUPS` | integer |  | derived |  |  |  | The number of ownership groups among the members (1 on a group page; every group on ALL) |
| `MEMBERS_IN_GLEIF` | integer |  | derived |  |  |  | The larger of GLEIF_GROUP_SIZE and MEMBERS |
| `CAPPED` | boolean |  | derived |  |  |  | True when GLEIF has more members than the lake holds (the committed snapshot keeps at most 50 a group) |
| `BY_COUNTRY` | record list |  | derived |  |  |  | Members by country code: rows of label, value (members) and count, largest first, the top 20 |
| `BY_LEGAL_FORM` | record list |  | derived |  |  |  | Members by legal form, largest first, the top 15 |
| `GROUP_ROWS` | record list |  | derived |  |  |  | ALL only: the rows of every group's ultimate parent, largest in GLEIF first (empty on a group page) |
| `BY_SEGMENT` | record list |  | derived |  |  |  | The seeded members by segment |

### LEIR: LEI parent relationship (`lei-relationship`)

One consolidation relationship from GLEIF's level 2 data: the child, its direct or ultimate parent, status and periods.

**Class** fundamental · **Key** `RELATIONSHIP_ID` · **Dated by** `snapshot` · **Cadence** static · **Stored by** connector `gleif-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/gleif/lei-relationship/` · **Ids** `^LEIREL-`.

**Grain:** One row per lei parent relationship, keyed by RELATIONSHIP_ID. **Contract:** `contracts/lei-relationship.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#leir-lei-parent-relationship-lei-relationship)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RELATIONSHIP_ID` | id | key | required |  | `LEIREL-010PWNH4K3BLIC3I7R03-DIRECT` (pattern `^LEIREL-`) |  | The record's id (the business key) |
| `LEVEL` | text |  | required |  | `Direct`, `Ultimate` |  | Direct (the child's direct parent) or Ultimate (its ultimate parent). |
| `CHILD_ENTITY` | id |  | required |  | `010PWNH4K3BLIC3I7R03` (pattern `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`) | `lei-entity` | The child in the relationship: an LEI of the lei-entity kind (20 characters). |
| `PARENT_ENTITY` | id |  | required |  | `549300COKYB5EGSU1838` (pattern `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`) | `lei-entity` | The parent in the relationship (direct or ultimate, per LEVEL): an LEI of the lei-entity kind. |
| `RELATIONSHIP_STATUS` | text |  | required |  | `ACTIVE` |  | Whether the relationship holds: ACTIVE or INACTIVE (GLEIF relationship status). |
| `START` | date |  | required |  | `2017-12-06` |  | The date the relationship started (the GLEIF relationship record's period start), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `END` | date |  | optional |  | `2025-06-30` |  | The date the relationship ended (the GLEIF relationship record's period end); absent while it holds. |
| `PERIODS` | record list |  | required |  |  |  | The relationship's other periods in GLEIF (the accounting period and the document filing period of the consolidation), one element each: TYPE, START and END. |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | text |  | required |  | `LAPSED`, `PUBLISHED` |  | The relationship record's registration status in GLEIF (PUBLISHED, LAPSED ...). |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date |  | required |  | `2023-08-08` |  | The date the relationship record was first registered with GLEIF, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date |  | required |  | `2024-10-07` |  | The date GLEIF's relationship record was last changed, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date |  | required |  | `2024-10-07` |  | The date the relationship record must be renewed by, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `LEI_GROUP` | id |  | required |  | `549300B2Q47IR0CR5B54` | `lei-group` | The child's ownership group: the LEI of its ultimate parent, the id of the computed lei-group kind. |
| `ACCOUNTING_STANDARD` | text |  | optional |  | `IFRS`, `OTHER_ACCOUNTING_STANDARD`, `US_GAAP` |  | The accounting standard of the consolidation the relationship is based on (IFRS, US_GAAP, OTHER_ACCOUNTING_STANDARD), comma-separated when several. |

Nested `PERIODS[]`:

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TYPE` | text |  | required |  | `accounting period`, `document filing period` |  | The period's type in lower case: accounting period or document filing period. |
| `START` | date |  | optional |  | `2021-01-01` |  | The first day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD; absent when GLEIF gives none. |
| `END` | date |  | optional |  | `2021-12-31` |  | The end of the period (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when it is open. |

**Links:** `CHILD_ENTITY` → `lei-entity`, `PARENT_ENTITY` → `lei-entity`, `LEI_GROUP` → `lei-group`.

- 1.1: END, the relationship's end date, is in the contract; PERIODS[].START is optional (GLEIF leaves it out of a few periods).

### LEIM: ISIN or BIC to LEI (`lei-mapping`)

An ISIN, BIC or MIC and the legal entity GLEIF's mapping files give it.

**Class** fundamental · **Key** `IDENTIFIER` · **Dated by** `snapshot` · **Cadence** static · **Stored by** connector `gleif-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/gleif/lei-mapping/`.

**Grain:** One row per isin or bic to lei, keyed by IDENTIFIER. **Contract:** `contracts/lei-mapping.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md#leim-isin-or-bic-to-lei-lei-mapping)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IDENTIFIER` | id | key | required |  | `WABTUS3WXXX` |  | The identifier GLEIF maps to an LEI: an ISIN (12 characters), a BIC (8 or 11) or a MIC (4); the record's key. |
| `TYPE` | text |  | required |  | `BIC`, `ISIN`, `MIC` |  | What IDENTIFIER is: ISIN, BIC or MIC (the mapping file it came from). |
| `ENTITY_LEI` | id |  | required |  | `06BTX5UWZD0GQ5N5Y745` (pattern `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`) | `lei-entity` | The entity the identifier belongs to: an LEI of the lei-entity kind (20 characters). |
| `ENTITY_NAME` | text |  | required |  | `WESTINGHOUSE AIR BRAKE TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION` |  | The legal name of that entity, as in its GLEIF record. |
| `COUNTRY` | text |  | required |  | `US` |  | The legal address country of the entity the identifier maps to (ISO 3166 alpha-2). |
| `LEI_GROUP` | id |  | required |  | `06BTX5UWZD0GQ5N5Y745` | `lei-group` | The entity's ownership group: the LEI of its ultimate parent, the id of the computed lei-group kind. |
| `MAPPING_FILE` | text |  | required |  | `LEI-BIC-20260925.zip`, `LEI-MIC-20261012.zip`, `isin-lei-20261024T071512.zip` |  | The GLEIF mapping file the pair was read from (isin-lei-…, LEI-BIC-…, LEI-MIC-….zip), which dates it. |
| `ISIN_COUNT` | integer |  | optional |  | `909` |  | ISINs of the issuer |

**Links:** `ENTITY_LEI` → `lei-entity`, `LEI_GROUP` → `lei-group`.

## Data retrieval

Where each kind's data comes from, how it reaches the lake and how to check it. Three origins: **external** data, fetched from a public source by the pack's refresh script (each source, its licence and worked examples on the [External data](../../../../docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md) help page); **synthetic** test data (or hand-written reference data), written by a generator with fictitious names; **computed** by a Drishti engine when it is asked, never stored by a source.

| Command | Kind | Origin | How it reaches Drishti |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | `lei-entity` | external: GLEIF LEI API: LEI records, legal forms, countries, LEI issuers (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF golden copy, level 2: relationship records and reporting exceptions (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF mapping files: BIC, ISIN, MIC and OpenCorporates to LEI (CC0 1.0) — refreshed by `tools/publicdata/gleif.py` | `data/testdata/gleif/lei-entity/` → `lake demo` → connector `gleif-store` |
| `LEIG` | `lei-group` | computed by Drishti: the derived connector gleif-groupings over the kind lei-entity; see the [Groupings and analytics guide](../../../../docs/guides/GROUPINGS_ANALYTICS_GUIDE.md) | nothing to load: computed from its inputs when asked |
| `LEIR` | `lei-relationship` | external: GLEIF LEI API: LEI records, legal forms, countries, LEI issuers (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF golden copy, level 2: relationship records and reporting exceptions (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF mapping files: BIC, ISIN, MIC and OpenCorporates to LEI (CC0 1.0) — refreshed by `tools/publicdata/gleif.py` | `data/testdata/gleif/lei-relationship/` → `lake demo` → connector `gleif-store` |
| `LEIC` | `lei-country` | computed by Drishti: the derived connector gleif-groupings over the kind lei-entity; see the [Groupings and analytics guide](../../../../docs/guides/GROUPINGS_ANALYTICS_GUIDE.md) | nothing to load: computed from its inputs when asked |
| `LEIM` | `lei-mapping` | external: GLEIF LEI API: LEI records, legal forms, countries, LEI issuers (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF golden copy, level 2: relationship records and reporting exceptions (CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)); GLEIF mapping files: BIC, ISIN, MIC and OpenCorporates to LEI (CC0 1.0) — refreshed by `tools/publicdata/gleif.py` | `data/testdata/gleif/lei-mapping/` → `lake demo` → connector `gleif-store` |

### External sources

| Source | Where | Licence | Internal only | Refresh |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GLEIF LEI API: LEI records, legal forms, countries, LEI issuers | https://api.gleif.org/api/v1 | CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated) | no | `python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh api` |
| GLEIF golden copy, level 2: relationship records and reporting exceptions | https://goldencopy.gleif.org | CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated) | no | `python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh golden` |
| GLEIF mapping files: BIC, ISIN, MIC and OpenCorporates to LEI | https://mapping.gleif.org | CC0 1.0 | no | `python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh mapping` |

```bash
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py status                                # each source: licence, internal only or not, last refreshed (offline)
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh --dry-run                     # what would be fetched and written; changes nothing
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh                               # the committed pack: data/testdata/gleif, samples/ and this guide, then make.py --check
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh --offline                     # the same from the download cache only
python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py refresh --scope NAME:allianz,CAP:200  # a widened build in <data>/publicdata/gleif
```

The same through the wrappers: `tools/publicdata/gleif.sh status` on Linux and macOS, `.\tools\windows\publicdata-gleif.ps1 status` on Windows (every argument is passed on).

### Into the lake, checking, offline

- **The lake.** `python3 tools/drishti.py lake demo` reads `data/testdata/testdata.yaml` and writes every dataset (test data, the packs' samples and the committed public-data snapshots) into `<data>/delta/<domain>/<kind>/`, where the pack's Delta connector serves it; a computed kind needs nothing loaded. `lake build` loads your own large JSON exports the same way ([Tools](../../../../docs/guides/TOOLS.md)).
- **Checking.** `python3 tools/contracts.py check` compares every contract with the pack and its data; each generator's `--check` (above) fails when the committed files differ from what it would write; in the console, `<MNEMONIC> <GO>` lists a kind and the pack's code opens its overview with the count of each kind.
- **Offline.** Everything committed works without a network: the test data, the samples and the public-data snapshots are in the repository and `lake demo` reads only them. A refresh script runs offline from its download cache (`--offline`); a connector that reaches the internet (news, yfinance, the public-data feeds) is off as shipped and never starts on a machine configured offline (`drishti.offline.plugins`).
